recipe.notes: RTFM official defaults (option.py) for both datasets: the repository has no XD-Violence configuration. Official unit 32, so there is no X.32 arm. The margin is the only scale constant (D4 x{1/10, 1, 10}); alpha, smooth and sparsity weights are loss weights. See the module docstring for the adaptations. Paper vs code (the code at cf938f4c is followed): the paper (arXiv 2101.10030 Sec. 4.2) states Adam weight decay 0.0005, lr 0.001 (ShanghaiTech, UCF-Crime) and 0.0001 (XD-Violence), batch 64 for 50 epochs; the code uses weight decay 0.005, lr 0.001 for every dataset and 15000 steps; the paper's XD lr is x1/10 of the code value (closest D4 value: the widened x1/9, base grid x1/3). The code's magnitude loss (|m - ||f_a||| + ||f_n||)^2 differs from the paper's hinge (Eq. 6), and the code drops out the top-k selection mask. Loss parts mag_abnormal / mag_normal: batch means of the top-k feature magnitudes (diagnostics, not in the cost).

d4.seeds_used: the first development seed of the list that did not collapse (PLAN.md 단일 seed 실행과 판정)
d4.score: per seed the mean of the 5 highest of the 30 evaluation points' sigma W-readout validation V-AUCs, then the mean over the seeds
d4.choice: strict > on the score; a float64 tie with the official value keeps it; other ties: closer to the official value (|log m|), then the smaller multiplier
d4.widening: lr only, once, in the direction of a winning end value; scale constants are not widened
d4.eligibility: a value takes part in the choice only with at least 1 development seeds that did not collapse (selected sigma V-AUC >= 0.60, PLAN.md 붕괴 제외) or fail numerically (a non-finite V-AUC); none eligible: the official value (recorded)
